title: Group Anagrams
statement: Read an integer n, then n lowercase words (one per line, letters only). Group the words so that words in the same group are anagrams of each other (contain exactly the same letters with the same multiplicity). Within each group, sort the words alphabetically and join them with a single space. Then order the groups by their sorted-letters 'signature' (e.g. 'eat' -> 'aet') and print one group per line.
starter_code:
n = int(input())
words = [input().strip() for _ in range(n)]
